senses.gloss: ch. sameto be pressed; to shrink, be lean, v. נָצָא II.

units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 26:20">Targ. Gen. XXVI, 20</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—Part. <cite ref="N01120"><he>נָצֵי</he></cite>, <he>נָאצֵי</he>; f. <cite ref="N01121"><he>נַצְיָא</he></cite>; pl. <cite ref="R00635"><he>נָצָן</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 26:17">Targ. Prov. XXVI, 17</cite> <he>נא׳</he> ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. <cite ref="N01120"><he>נְצֵי</he></cite>, corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 2:13">Targ. Ex. II, 13</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16a:10">M. Kat. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>דנְצִינָן וכ׳</he> that we (the court) must contend (with persons disregarding legal summonses) and curse &c.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 45:24">Targ. Gen. XLV, 24</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84b:10">B. Mets. 84ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה קא מִינַּצְיָא וכ׳</he> his wife was quarrelling with &c.

Kidd. 76ᵃ נשי דכי מִינְּצוּ בהדי הדדי בעריות הוא דמִינְּצוּ when women quarrel with one another, they will eventually reproach one another with unchaste conduct; גברי … ביוחסין הוא דמינצו when men quarrel, they will reproach each other with spurious descent (if there is any rumor about it). Ib.ᵇ. כיון דמִנְּצוּ בהדי אינשי (or דמְנַצּוּ Pa.) because they (charity collectors) expose themselves to reproaches. Ib. והוה קא מִנְּצֵי איהו וכ׳ (or מְנַצֵּי) he and Rab Bibi strove with each other, one saying, I want the town office &c.
<cite ref="Megillah 24a:14">Meg. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>משום דאתי לאִינַּצּוּיֵי</he> because it may come to quarrels between them.
<cite ref="Megillah 24b">Ib. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>אינצי אביו ומינצי רבו</he> Ms. M. (ed. <cite ref="N00748"><he>נִיצּוּיֵי</he></cite>) his father may take up the quarrel for him, or his teacher.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 117a:17">B. Kam. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>מנצו</he>, v. <cite ref="U00581"><he>שׁוּתָא</he> III</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 3:7">Targ. Koh. III, 7</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Megillah 24a:16">Meg. 24ᵃ</cite> <he>קטן בר נַצּוּיֵי הוא</he> will a minor quarrel (about precedence)? <cite ref="Berakhot 56a">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מְנַצּוּ</he> (Beth N. <he>מִינְּצֵי</he>); a. e. (v. supra).
